title: Theorem Learner: proofs from concepts to results
summary: Learn mathematics from basic concepts to advanced results. Each theorem has its exact statement and one or more separate proofs; each proof shows how its hypotheses feed its steps and conclusion, with a small diagram, terse step slogans and concept reminders on every concept word. A theory graph joins concepts, proof mechanisms, proofs and theorems without one fixed order. Works offline.
